description: This file defines Express.js routes for authentication endpoints, including registration, login, token refresh, validation, and fetching current user info. It integrates with controllers and middleware, and includes Swagger documentation for API endpoints.

methods.name: router.post('/register')
methods.description: Sets up the registration endpoint to handle user sign-up, delegating to authController.register.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Sets up the login endpoint, delegating to authController.login.

methods.name: router.post('/refresh')
methods.description: Sets up the token refresh endpoint, delegated to authController.refresh.

methods.name: router.get('/validate')
methods.description: Sets up token validation endpoint, using optionalAuth middleware and delegated to authController.validate.

methods.name: router.get('/me')
methods.description: Sets up endpoint to fetch current user info, protected by requireAuth middleware, delegated to authController.me.
